title: AnalogPortBench: Benchmarking LLMs on Analog Circuit Porting
abstract: arXiv:2610.33088v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Analog circuit design still relies heavily on expert knowledge, and porting proven designs to new process nodes is a recurring bottleneck. As a lower supply reduces available voltage headroom, a working topology may require redesign or fail to meet specifications. While large language models (LLMs) have begun to generate and optimize analog circuits, existing benchmarks focus on one process node and assume feasible specifications. To bridge this gap, we introduce AnalogPortBench, a benchmark of 54 tasks for porting ten circuits, from current mirrors to telescopic amplifiers, from a 0.18 $\mu$m process to the open-source SKY130 PDK. Tasks range from a direct port through a reduced supply and harder specifications to infeasible ones, and every feasible task has a reference design verified at five process corners. translated_title: AnalogPortBench：大语言模型在模拟电路移植任务上的基准测试
translated_abstract: 模拟电路设计仍然严重依赖专家知识，而将经过验证的设计移植到新的工艺节点是一个反复出现的瓶颈。由于电源电压降低会压缩可用的电压裕量，原本工作正常的电路拓扑可能需要重新设计，甚至无法满足规格要求。尽管大语言模型（LLM）已开始用于生成和优化模拟电路，但现有基准测试仅针对单一工艺节点，并默认规格是可实现的。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了 AnalogPortBench，这是一个包含 54 个任务的基准测试，要求将十个电路（从电流镜到套筒式放大器）从 0.18 μm 工艺移植到开源的 SKY130 PDK 工艺。任务难度从直接移植，到降低电源电压和收紧规格要求，再到不可实现的移植场景；每个可行任务都配有经过五个工艺角验证的参考设计。我们在两个推理等级下评估了六个前沿大语言模型，并分别在有仿真反馈和无仿真反馈的条件下进行测试，结果显示模型能够移植简单的电流镜……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出首个评估大语言模型模拟电路跨工艺节点移植能力的基准测试 AnalogPortBench，包含54个从0.18μm工艺到开源SKY130 PDK的移植任务，涵盖可行与不可行场景，并用六个前沿大模型进行了系统评估。
en_tdlr: Introduces AnalogPortBench, a benchmark of 54 tasks evaluating frontier LLMs on porting analog circuits across process nodes from 0.18μm to the open-source SKY130 PDK, covering both feasible and infeasible porting scenarios with verified reference designs.
